description: This file defines a React component 'ExploreClient' for the frontend UI of a career exploration web application. It manages search, filters, and display of role recommendations via cards or mind map view, with interaction with external APIs and local storage.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a trimmed string, handling nulls and undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an array of normalized strings, filtering out falsy values.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses salary range information from a role object into min and max values in Lakhs.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the role title from a role object.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if a given role matches the current filter criteria including industry, skills, salary range, and title query.

methods.name: ExploreClient
methods.description: Main React component rendering the career exploration interface with search, filters, and result views.
